name: The Depths — Episode 2: The Cracked Hull

reveil.title: The Hold
reveil.narrator: On a dead ship, silence is sometimes the only ally that doesn't lie.
reveil.text:
You regain consciousness in the Derelicta's air pocket.

The portal coordinates still glow on your HUD:

**SECTOR 7 — 800 m**

The hold tilts under your weight. Water seeps through the seams — drop after drop, steady, patient.

Your lamp: **38%**. Air: maybe two hours.

To descend toward sector 7, you must cross the hull — forward, where the **main crack** opened the Derelicta to the ocean.

choices.text: Move forward immediately into the flooded corridor
Test the radio one last time before moving

radio_decalee.title: Offset Voice
radio_decalee.narrator: When communications glitch, you no longer know who is speaking — or when.
radio_decalee.text:
You open the channel.

Static. Breathing. Then your own voice — **recorded**, distorted:

*« —…800 metres… too late… don't cross the— »*

The sentence cuts off. You haven't **said** that yet. You haven't **thought** it.

A second later, the familiar voice returns, clear, present:

*« —{{player}}? You're still in the hold. Good. Move forward. — »*

As if it had seen you hesitate.

choices.text: Note the offset message and move forward

couloir.title: Flooded Corridor
couloir.narrator: In a tilted corridor, water always picks a side.
couloir.text:
You leave the hold.

Corridor B is flooded to your chest. Your magnetic boots struggle on the smooth metal.

Alarm panels blink without sound: the Derelicta has forgotten how to scream.

In the distance, a continuous rumble — not sonar. Not metal. Something like a **breath** through a wound.

The main crack. Close.

fissure.title: The Main Crack
fissure.narrator: A breach in a ship is a mouth. The ocean knows how to feed.
fissure.text:
You arrive facing it.

The crack runs through the hull for five metres — twisted metal edge, black water **pouring** in a compact jet, almost silent at this depth.

On the other side: the ocean. No visible lateral passage.

Your HUD overlays two routes:

**A — Direct crossing** (15 m through the jet)
**B — Technical duct C-12** (detour · +8 min · battery)

Your lamp: **34%**.

traversee.title: In the Jet
traversee.narrator: Crossing an open wound means accepting you'll be carried for an instant.
traversee.text:
You dive into the jet.

Pressure hits you sideways — dizziness, breath cut short. Your lamp sweeps bubbles, foam fragments, **nothing solid**.

You switch off for a moment to save power — reflex.

In the black of the current, something **brushes** your suit. Long. Flexible. Too long for a cable.

The water changes temperature — barely — like a breath.

choices.text: 🔦 Switch on — see what touched you
🫧 Let the current carry you — without light

audace_jet.title: Flash in the Current
audace_jet.narrator: Sometimes seeing means confirming you should have kept swimming.
audace_jet.text:
You switch on.

A patch of pale skin — smooth, no visible scales — vanishes **into** the jet, so fast you doubt it.

No head. No tail. Just the **part** your light touched for a fraction of a second.

The radio crackles:

*« —Don't stop. — »*

You burst out the other side, gasping. Battery: **29%**.

choices.text: Reach the airlock before the battery dies

lucidite_jet.title: Carried by the Current
lucidite_jet.narrator: Closing your eyes is sometimes the only way to hold your course.
lucidite_jet.text:
You don't switch on.

The current carries you — right elbow, head down, hands on your suit. You count. Five seconds. Ten.

The jet changes texture: less violent. **Exit.**

You stop in a dark cavity, out of the current. Nothing touched you — you **think**.

A distant ping. Yours? No. Too low.

Battery: **31%** — you saved two points by staying in the dark.

choices.text: Switch on briefly — locate the airlock

gaine.title: Duct C-12
gaine.narrator: Narrow passages offer no view — only time to think.
gaine.text:
The C-12 hatch groans. You crawl through a conduit barely wider than your shoulders.

No jet here — just water rising slowly, centimetre by centimetre.

You switch off the lamp. Conservation.

In the dark, the hull **vibrates** — long crack, like a bone giving way. The crack widens by a millimetre. You **feel** it more than you hear it.

The radio murmurs, almost drowned:

*« —…correct detour… can you hear the hull… — »*

choices.text: 🫧 Move forward blind — exit the duct

gaine_lumiere.title: Breathing Crack
gaine_lumiere.narrator: Watching a crack grow means measuring the time you have left.
gaine_lumiere.text:
You switch on.

Through a grille, you see the crack — water entering in waves, steady, **like a breath**.

On the metal edge, marks: long, parallel. Scratches? Corrosion? Three times longer than your hand.

You don't stay to count.

Battery: **28%**.

choices.text: Exit the duct toward the airlock

gaine_sombre.title: Blind
gaine_sombre.narrator: When you see nothing, every metre counts double.
gaine_sombre.text:
You move forward without light — left hand on the conduit, right in front of your face.

Three metres. Five. Seven.

Your fingers find a ladder. **Exit.**

You didn't see the scratches. You didn't see the crack breathing.

Maybe that's better.

Battery: **32%**.

choices.text: Open the hatch — reach the airlock

sas.title: External Airlock
sas.narrator: An airlock is a boundary. On one side, the ship. On the other, everything.
sas.text:
You enter airlock 3 — half-flooded, but stable.

Outside, through the porthole: the ocean. Total black. And lower, very low, an **orange glow** — faint, pulsed, like a distant heartbeat.

**SECTOR 7.** You're on the route.

The HUD recalculates:

**620 m remaining · current depth 180 m · heading 214°**

The radio:

*« —{{player}}. Next stage: the descent. Sonar sometimes lies. You don't. — »*

Then silence.

choices.text: Flood the airlock and dive toward the glow

fin_coque.title: On the Other Side
fin_coque.narrator: Leaving a dead ship means accepting the real danger wasn't inside.
fin_coque.text:
You open the airlock.

The water swallows you — clean, cold, **immense**.

The Derelicta disappears above you, a silhouette melting into the black.

Below, the orange glow still pulses. 620 metres. Sector 7.

Your lamp: **26%**. Enough to descend. Not enough to return.

**END EPISODE 2 — The Cracked Hull**
